qwen_warmup_keepalive.formula: 1 initial warmup request + at most 80 pings at 15-second intervals during a 20-minute warmup window
qwen_warmup_keepalive.constraint: No concurrent keepalive during active scored traffic; scored calls serve as activity. Stop when this reserve is exhausted.

retries_and_capacity_failures.constraint: Shared cap across models; at most one retry for a failed scored/smoke call, never exceeding this ledger reserve; stop after five consecutive network/capacity failures.

ambiguous_submission_reconciliation_cont.constraint: No blind resubmission. This count is available only after reconciliation proves no duplicate; otherwise stop with a failure receipt.

two_models.status: scenario_only; omission requires an explicit evidence-backed matrix decision

one_model.status: scenario_only; omission requires an explicit evidence-backed matrix decision

assumptions: One scored provider request is counted for every document-view-model tuple, regardless of success, parse result, capacity result, or billing outcome.
The nine views are three unchanged calls, three Pad calls, and three Grid-Warp calls.
Single-run, unchanged, Pad, Grid-Warp, visual-mixed, and all-view ensembles are derived from the nine stored responses and generate no provider calls.
Smoke calls are conservatively additional to scored calls; no reuse credit is assumed.

The recommended synchronous direct routes have no provider-budget-consuming poll calls. Selecting a batch fallback requires a revised ledger that explicitly counts any poll/control calls that consume the same cap.
The existing Qwen runner's always-on 15-second keepalive thread is not authorized; it must be disabled during active scored traffic.
Historical Gemini 2.0 Flash responses consume zero new requests and no new Gemini 2.0 Flash call is allowed.
All fields are counts, not monetary cost estimates. Pricing and token-cost provenance must be recorded separately if execution is authorized.
